title: observability: kv token metrics + cost/latency dashboards and alert tuning (logging enhancements)
author: Evelyn Park
description: Add token-level KV cache metrics, token cost/latency breakdown dashboards, KV-specific tracing spans, and alert tuning to reduce noise. This change wires KV cache hit/miss counters and per-token cost attribution into the observability pipeline, adds a new Grafana dashboard with per-route/per-model panels (token cost, token latency, KV hit-rate, KV latency histogram), and introduces new alert rules tuned to realistic traffic (ENG-4821). Also includes logging context enhancements (request_id, route, model, kv_key_bucket) to make traces linkable from logs to spans. Checklist: - [x] metric instrumentation (runtime/kv) - [x] tracing spans for KV operations - [x] dashboards (grafana provisioning) - [x] alert rules and thresholds - [x] docs and runbook updates - [x] SDK examples and dashboard links. Motivation: noisy KV/ordering alerts were causing repeated on-call interruptions and unclear root cause when token-level costs spiked; this PR centralizes token attribution and adds focused alerts for genuine regressions. Related: ENG-4821, SRE-210.
